review.problem: His first seven terms (1993 to 2007) were in the U.S. House for Ohio's 13th District; he sat in the Senate only from January 2007 to January 2025. The roster's terms seem to have been merged under the last chamber. Read here on Wikipedia; the Biographical Directory of Congress (bioguide.congress.gov/search/bio/B000944) is the official record to confirm against, but it answered this script with 403.
